# Merge conflict_091026_2226 into main

This pull request merges the Agent-From-Creator bundle feature and related improvements from the conflict_091026_2226 branch into main.

## Summary of Changes

### Backend
- **Agent Bundle Creation** (`/api/chat/agents/bundle`): Creates 3 coordinated tasks (image, video, music) from a single creative idea
- **Luchii Model Selection**: Enhanced video endpoint to accept `luchii_model` parameter with auto-selection:
  - **Luchii Cinematica** - text-to-video (default when no image)
  - **Luchii Animus** - image-to-video (auto-selected when image provided)
  - **Luchii Harmonia** - audio generation
- **Retry Logic**: Added automatic retry mechanism for rate-limited (429) image generation requests
- **Comprehensive Test Suite**: Added 8 pytest cases covering bundle creation, ordering, authentication, and model selection

### Frontend
- **LuchiiAgent Page**: Updated task status display to recognize "waiting" state for queued tasks
- **Video Model Picker**: Allows creators to select video model with auto-guidance based on image presence
- **Chat Developer Docs**: New `/developers` page documenting all chat and agent endpoints with examples

### Configuration & Testing
- `.gitignore`: Added model cache paths
- `.emergent/emergent.yml`: Updated environment configuration
- `test_reports/iteration_17.json`: Comprehensive test report documenting all validations

## Testing Status
✅ **All 8 backend pytest tests passing (100% success rate)**
- Bundle authentication and authorization verified
- Model selection logic validated
- Task ordering confirmed
- Cross-user access control tested

## Known Behavior
- Frasberg upstream image endpoint is currently queue-throttling, which may cause initial image tasks to show "Failed" status. Subsequent video tasks proceed as designed (sequential execution).
- This is upstream behavior, not a code issue. The bundle correctly captures and handles throttle errors.

## Files Changed
- `backend/server.py` - Agent bundle endpoints + retry logic
- `backend/tests/test_agents_bundle.py` - New test suite (109 lines)
- `frontend/src/pages/LuchiiAgent.jsx` - Status state handling
- `frontend/src/pages/ChatDocs.jsx` - Developer documentation
- `.gitignore` - Model cache exclusions
- `.emergent/emergent.yml` - Build configuration
